features: Portability: Take your viewing beyond home with the portable ZEB-Pixaplay 24 as you can carry it anywhere with its convenient strap for impressive projections on the go.
Screen size: Experience exceptional home theatre with the ZEB-Pixaplay 24, offering LED projection up to 406 cm for movies, series, and gaming on a large screen.
Brightness: The projector features a high-brightness LED lamp with 4000 lumens and supports 1080p FHD resolution, delivering clear, detailed content on large screens.
Built-in speaker: Enjoy non-stop movie marathons with the ZEB-Pixaplay 24, featuring a built-in powerful speaker for fantastic audio.
Lifelong LED lamp: With a 30,000-hour lamp life, the ZEB-Pixaplay 24 offers endless projection at home.
